scope: Finite authored future analyst setups only; no rendered audio, MIDI/ALS fixtures, original run or candidate comparison
F0: Disposable editable Set, isolated active device; explicitly retain actual accepted controls, routes, section enables, MIDI/input identity and output attenuation. No custom defaults, automation, macros or unrelated routing unless named.

Authored baseline 4/4, 120 BPM, 48 kHz. Compare separated note60 on beat1/off beat2 and overlapping notes48/60 on beats1/2/off beats3/4, admitted nonzero velocities. These are stimuli choices, not device limits or timing laws.

For Corpus/Amp/Cabinet before execution retain owned audio A: 440+1000 Hz transient/sustain pattern with bounded total peak 0.1; independent B: 997 Hz pulse in a later interval. Pin exact frames/rate/channels/bytes/hash before use. No sample is produced by this author tool.

MPE cases require independently identified notes and events, distinct global/per-note bend and pressure/slide, and actually offered targets. Do not infer a wire codec, arbitrary-controller support or Set tuning from a field name.
positive-path-guard: Require independently identified nonzero source and output, active oscillator/exciter/resonator/effect/filter/amplifier as applicable, admitted nonzero relevant gain/send/wet/base/depth, and matched active positive control before no-effect/disabled/zero comparisons. Isolate other sources, dry-only paths and competing modulation. A silent Collision constructor, unexcited Tension setting, absent MIDI, muted output or zero wet path is inconclusive. For Corpus distinguish old tail from new input. Unknown or failed prerequisites remain U.

No fake Live identity, CoreFoundation/Objective-C shim host, original code, native probe, emulator, runtime, installation or implementation is run or created. Future positive wet response is an unproven prerequisite, not a claimed feasible host.
